title: Joint Level II Officer (I) (Col to Capt) FMOS, DC M&RA
raw_text:
1.     MOS 9701, Joint Level II Officer (I) (Col to Capt) FMOS, DC M&RA

    a. Summary. Joint Level II Officers are officers that do not fully
qualify for the 9702 joint MOS. Joint Level II Officers are recognized for
their joint matters experience and completion of Joint Professional Military
Education (JPME) I. The Secretary of the Military Department is the approval
authority for 9701.

       b.    Prerequisites

             (1) Must be at minimum in the grade of O3.

             (2) Certified by the commandant of the Marine Corps.

        (3) Must be identified as a Joint Level II Officer through the Joint
Duty Assignment Management Information System.

        (4) Must have been assigned to a standard joint duty assignment (S-
JDA) or gain experience points through joint matters experience. S-JDAs only
include those positions that are on the joint duty assignment list.

       c.    Requirements

        (1) Must accrue 12 joint qualification points (a minimum of 6 of the
12 points must be derived from joint duty or experiences other than joint
training or joint exercises) or have been awarded full joint duty credit in a
S-JDA. Joint qualification points for experience are approved through the
Joint Staff Experience-Based Joint Duty Assignment Board.

             (2) Must successfully complete JPME Phase I.

        (3) May accrue up to 6 discretionary points derived from joint
training, joint exercises, and education or training other than JPME that
enhances an officers knowledge and understanding of joint matters.

        (4) Officers who have full joint tour credit and have completed JPME
Phase I may be designated as Level II by the Commandant of the Marine Corps.

    d. Duties. The duties will be as prescribed and designated by the
command or activity to which assigned.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Officer Military Training/Reporting/Special Duty Code (no related SOC) 00-
0002.

       f.    Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
